author: GitHub
description:
Go from a GitHub issue prompt to a deployed, production-ready AI agent without switching between browser tabs or cloud portals. In this hands-on walkthrough, learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry Skill and Foundry Canvas inside the GitHub Copilot app to build a grounded backer concierge for Tailspin Toys. Watch as Copilot provisions Azure resources, selects and deploys a model, tests against hallucinations, and sets up a credential-safe proxy. Complete the self-paced workshop here: https://github-samples.github.io/copilot-workshops/real-world-development/app/8-foundry-canvas/

— CHAPTERS —  

0:00 Introduction 
0:58 Prepare the data 
1:39 Create Azure resources 
2:04 Select and deploy a model 
5:08 Build the hosted agent 
5:51 Deploy the agent to Foundry 
7:45 Build a secure functions proxy 
8:11 Add the website chat widget 
8:28 Test the backer concierge agent
